package planted

// A PLANTED second instance of the defect class the guard in claimref_guard_test.go exists to
// catch: a receive-pack request built without the sideband capture, so a refusal from the server
// would arrive as its bare report-status word. The guard MUST flag this file; if it reports it
// clean, the guard's matcher has stopped matching.

import (
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/protocol/packp"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/protocol/packp/capability"
)

func plantedRequest(adv *capability.List) *packp.ReferenceUpdateRequest {
	return packp.NewReferenceUpdateRequestFromCapabilities(adv)
}
